title: cf-stability: string stability of learned car-following models
description: Code, configurations, run manifests and results of the study "String Stability of Learned Car-Following Models: Audit, Differentiable Penalties, a Certified Hybrid and Corridor-Level Validation" (submitted to Mathematics, MDPI, 2026): an audit of the equilibrium (string) stability of learned car-following models, differentiable stability penalties, a residual hybrid with an a priori certificate, and the validation of the laws on SUMO corridors of NGSIM I-80 and US-101. The archive holds the code, the published tables, figures and report, and the run outputs they are computed from (training-run metrics and audits, per-event closed-loop metrics, corridor-run metrics and the compact speed fields of the figures, scenarios, law files, calibrations and fold definitions). The raw data, the extracted events and the simulated trajectories are not included; the README (section Reproduce) gives the three levels of reproduction and the data access steps.
